security.csp: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; media-src 'self' data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'

bundle.longDescription: Pocket Notes is a notes app that lives entirely on your device. Notebooks, sections and pages; a rich editor; links, tags, a board, a calendar and a graph of your notes; photos, voice notes and drawings; import and export in the open Weave (.weave) format. No account, no cloud, no network — your notes never leave your machine.
bundle.shortDescription: Pocket Notes — a notes app that lives on your device.
